The '''Naboo Spacelines StarSpeeder 1000''' was a modified [[StarSpeeder 1000]] spacecraft used by interstellar travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] to operate flights bound for the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Playset" /> prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="STAC" /> This starship was painted [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and light grey with a red circle containing a white [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Nern/Legends|Nern]].<ref name="STSF" /> It was named after both the planet as well as [[Naboo Spacelines]], a separate spaceliner company from Star Tours, which was a fellow member with Star Tours in the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]].

It was equipped with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] systems, two [[Flashcannon|flash cannons]] and two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]; it was crewed by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] and a [[systems analyst]].<ref name="Playset" /> It could support up to 40 passengers.<ref name="STAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo Spacelines StarSpeeder 1000 was first introduced on [[The Walt Disney Company]] website in [[2011]] as a papercraft model.<ref name="STSF" /> The speeder was also released in the same year in a set of diecast toys, the StarSpeeder 1000 Spaceliner Collection.<ref name="Playset" />

According to a ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' poster sign, only Star Tours flew StarSpeeder 1000s, which confirms Star Tours ownership of this vessel.<ref name="EnEx">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours-2/2011/06/star-tours-the-adventures-continue-june-3-2011/attachment/img_0659-2|text=IMG_0659}}</ref> The Japanese version, however, indicated that it was part of a separate company which was affiliated with Star Tours via the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]].
